name: Engadget

sources.title: About Engadget — owned by Static Media since 2026; lists editors/writers by name; phone (908) 514-8038, Static Media Fishers IN address; no tips inbox shown

requirements: Not a directory — coverage is earned editorial; no submission form or listing product
Engadget covers consumer tech: gadgets, apps, AI, computing, mobile, EVs, gaming, entertainment
All content is staff/contribution-written by named humans — site states a No-AI Writing Policy and that corporate sponsorships are never accepted for coverage
The catalog's stored website path (/about/advertist) is truncated — the working page is /about/contact/
preparation: A consumer-tech angle: a gadget, app, or consumer-facing AI/software story — B2B SaaS is a weak fit
Identify the editor/writer covering your beat from the masthead on the About page
Press kit with product details, images, pricing, availability; review unit or demo access if hardware/app
workflow: Pick the relevant editor or writer from https://www.engadget.com/about/contact/
Pitch them directly with a concise, newsworthy hook
Alternatively reach the newsroom via the Static Media contact channels (phone/address listed)
Coverage, if it happens, is a staff-written article — no listing page is created
watchFor: Ownership changed to Static Media in 2026 — historical tips@engadget.com conventions may no longer apply
No tips email is published on the contact page; only a phone number and licensing/jobs links
They explicitly never accept sponsorship for coverage — do not offer paid placement
Contributor pitches must be human-written; AI-generated articles are rejected per policy
countsAsLive: An Engadget article mentioning or reviewing the product is published at engadget.com
unknowns: A current tips/news inbox — none is listed on the about page
Whether guest/contributed pieces are still accepted under Static Media ownership
